lead: Build the quantity from the actual distribution plan, design versions and any planned reserve. Compare it with the selected configuration’s quoted minimum rather than increasing an order solely because of a generic industry number.
html:
Give Your Next Sourcing Decision a Clearer Direction

Bring these decisions back to your actual product, drink or brand project. Clear specifications, samples and approval targets help your team work from the same brief.

How should we assess usable demand before choosing a model?

Build the quantity from the actual distribution plan, design versions and any planned reserve. Compare it with the selected configuration’s quoted minimum rather than increasing an order solely because of a generic industry number.

What should the quotation and sample review include?

For how many custom cups to order for a campaign?, provide the use, model or reference, intended quantity and the information needed to review usable demand, design versions and confirmed minimums. Identify essential requirements and undecided items so the quote and sample review address the same brief.

How should a fixed project date be handled?

State the required arrival date and destination at the start. We will assist you with artwork or design, sample approval, production and transit milestones separately. We will help you review the timing impact of any change to an approved specification; service scope and timing need project confirmation.
